process_depth.description: Depth of process in execution hierarchy (2 if parent exists, else 1)

child_process_count.description: Number of process spawn events inside the window

unique_child_processes.description: Number of unique process names spawned as children in this window

parent_child_frequency.description: Frequency count of the parent-child pair in events

parent_child_rarity.description: Rarity score of the parent-child combination (1.0 if rare/unknown, 0.0 if common)

command_length.description: Length of process command line string

command_token_count.description: Number of whitespace-separated tokens in command line

encoded_command_flag.description: Flag representing potential base64 or encoded execution commands

script_interpreter_flag.description: Flag indicating process name is a script interpreter

lolbin_flag.description: Flag representing process matches a recognized LOLBin

unique_destination_count.description: Number of unique destination IP addresses

registry_modification_count.description: Number of registry modifications (creates, deletes, sets)

registry_create_count.description: Number of registry keys or values created

process_access_count.description: Number of times this process accessed another process

lsass_access_count.description: Number of process accesses specifically targeting LSASS memory

granted_access_entropy.description: Character entropy of the process granted access mask

integrity_level_change.description: Flag indicating multiple integrity levels occurred within the window

cross_user_process_count.description: Number of unique users associated with events in the window

rare_image_load_count.description: Number of images loaded from temp/appdata/public directories
